UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile containing stats and identity info

createdAt.description: Timestamp when user profile was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when user profile was last updated

LudoRoom.title: LudoRoom
LudoRoom.description: A multiplayer game room for Ludo matchmaking and real-time state sync

roomId.description: Unique 4 to 8 char room code or document ID

hostId.description: User ID of the room creator

status.description: Current lifecycle phase of the game room

isPublic.description: Whether room is available in public matchmaking queue

maxPlayers.description: Maximum number of allowed players (2 to 4)

playerIds.description: List of user IDs participating in this room

players.description: Player details including id, name, color, and ready state

dice.description: Current rolled dice value (1-6) or 0 if unrolled

rolled.description: Whether the active player has rolled the die

winner.description: Color of the winning player or empty string

tokens.description: Map of color to token positions array [step0, step1, step2, step3]

activeColors.description: List of active player colors in this game

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the room was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the room state was last modified

/users/{userId}.description: Collection of user profiles scoped by user ID

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Collection of multiplayer Ludo game and matchmaking rooms
